__comment: Item model for Sedna guns below 1.21.4, pointed at by gradle/legacy-assets.gradle.kts. The builtin/entity parent is what makes vanilla report isCustomRenderer() and hand the item to our BEWLR / DynamicItemRenderer; it is a marker with no geometry and no inherited transforms, so the display block is the weapon framing (the same values as gun_obj_base.json, which 26.1 uses). The first-person entries are irrelevant either way: that body rebuilds its pose from the camera.
